title: Choose between GPT and MBR partitioning
summary: Understand when to use GPT (modern, UEFI) versus MBR (legacy, BIOS) partitioning schemes.

steps.explain: Use GPT if you are using UEFI booting, have a disk larger than 2 TiB, or want modern features like unlimited primary partitions. Use MBR only if you must dual-boot with Windows using Legacy BIOS or have very old hardware that does not support GPT.
